# Layer5 Documentation

> Product Documentation

## Pages
- [Layer5](/pr-preview/pr-1233/index.md): Explore tutorials and documentation by product in the docs.layer5.io website; documentation and developer resources of Layer5 products.

- [Layer5 Helm Repository](/pr-preview/pr-1233/charts/index.md): Layer5 Helm Repository contains a collection of charts, including Layer5 Cloud, which can be deployed in any Kubernetes cluster on-premises or in Cloud using Helm.
- [Search Results](/pr-preview/pr-1233/search/index.md)

## Kanvas Documentation
- [Kanvas Documentation](/pr-preview/pr-1233/kanvas/index.md): Kanvas delivers a collaborative experience for engineers similar to how Google Workplace transforms the digital work environment and how Figma democratizes UX design tooling.

- [Performance Limits and Tuning](/pr-preview/pr-1233/kanvas/advanced/performance/index.md): Learn about the performance limits of Kanvas and how to tune your environment for optimal performance.

- [Understanding Design Components](/pr-preview/pr-1233/kanvas/designer/understanding-design-component/index.md): A complete reference for all components available in the Kanvas designer.
- [Design Render Quality](/pr-preview/pr-1233/kanvas/advanced/url-parameters/index.md): Control the level of detail in Kanvas design rendering using advanced URL query parameters.

- [Starting from scratch](/pr-preview/pr-1233/kanvas/getting-started/starting-scratch/index.md): Welcome to Kanvas, your comprehensive tool for creating and managing cloud native deployment designs. This documentation will guide you through the steps, emphasizing the underlying system behavior for each action you take.

- [Understanding Edge Styles](/pr-preview/pr-1233/kanvas/designer/understanding-edges/index.md): Learn how to use and customize edge styles in Kanvas to create clear and meaningful designs.

- [Validating Designs](/pr-preview/pr-1233/kanvas/tasks/designs/validating-designs/index.md): Prior to deploying a design, you can validate the configuration that it contains in accordance with the target platform.

- [Whiteboarding](/pr-preview/pr-1233/kanvas/tasks/whiteboarding/index.md): Kanvas Designer supports freestyle design, meaning that you can customize the appearance and layout of your diagrams without any constraints.

- [Auto-pan on Drag](/pr-preview/pr-1233/kanvas/advanced/autopan/index.md): Kanvas automatically pans the viewport while you drag a component past the canvas edge. Learn when it helps, how to toggle it, and the performance gates that decide when it stays active.

- [Dry Running a Design](/pr-preview/pr-1233/kanvas/tasks/designs/dry-running-a-design/index.md): A dry run simulates the deployment of your design in the selected target environment without making any actual changes.

- [Exploring Kubernetes Services with Meshery](/pr-preview/pr-1233/kanvas/tutorials/kubernetes/kubernetes-services/index.md): Explore Kubernetes Services using Meshery Playground, an interactive live environment, through a series of hands-on exercises.
- [Importing a Design](/pr-preview/pr-1233/kanvas/getting-started/import-designs/index.md): Learn how to import designs from various sources and formats, including Kubernetes manifests, Helm charts, Docker Compose files, and more.

- [Interpreting Component Badges](/pr-preview/pr-1233/kanvas/designer/interpreting-component-badges/index.md): Learn to interpret component badges, the small visual indicators that provide at-a-glance information about a component's status in both Designer and Operator modes.
- [Undeploying Designs](/pr-preview/pr-1233/kanvas/tasks/designs/undeploying-designs/index.md): Undeploy a design in order to rollback a deployment from one or more Kubernetes clusters.

- [Understanding Tool Modes](/pr-preview/pr-1233/kanvas/designer/understanding-tool-modes/index.md): Kanvas Designer offers three modes: Default, Pencil, and Connector, which behave differently based on the context in which they are used. Learn how to interact with components and the canvas in each mode.

- [Whiteboarding](/pr-preview/pr-1233/kanvas/designer/whiteboarding/index.md): Whiteboarding and Freestyle Drawing inside Kanvas
- [Creating Relationships](/pr-preview/pr-1233/kanvas/getting-started/creating-relationships/index.md): Relationships identify and facilitate genealogy between Components.

- [Deploying Designs](/pr-preview/pr-1233/kanvas/tasks/designs/deploying-designs/index.md): Each Meshery design is deployable to one or more Kubernetes clusters.

- [Publishing to Catalog](/pr-preview/pr-1233/kanvas/tutorials/publishing-to-catalog/index.md): Learn to Publish to Catalog

- [Render Modes](/pr-preview/pr-1233/kanvas/advanced/render-modes/index.md): Kanvas renders a design at four distinct levels of detail. Learn what each render mode shows, what it hides, the feature size gates tied to each mode, and how Adaptive Render Mode picks the right one automatically based on live performance signals.

- [Reviewing Designs](/pr-preview/pr-1233/kanvas/designer/comments/index.md): Learn how to leverage comments in Kanvas's Designer Mode to enhance collaboration and streamline design reviews.

- [Understanding  Relationships](/pr-preview/pr-1233/kanvas/concepts/relationships/index.md): Kanvas uses relationships to map how interconnected components interact.

- [Working with Components](/pr-preview/pr-1233/kanvas/getting-started/working-with-components/index.md): Meshery Components are reusable, interactive elements that can be used to build your designs. Learn how to work with components.

- [Cloning a Design](/pr-preview/pr-1233/kanvas/tasks/designs/cloning-a-design/index.md): Treat designs as templates by cloning an existing design to modify and build upon.

- [Collaborative Editing](/pr-preview/pr-1233/kanvas/tutorials/collaborative-editing/index.md): Learn about Collaborative Editing

- [Instance Details](/pr-preview/pr-1233/kanvas/operator/resource-details/index.md): Learn about Instance Details in Operator mode

- [Sharing Designs](/pr-preview/pr-1233/kanvas/designer/sharing/index.md): Share designs with other users and use access controls to manage design permissions and visibility.

- [Views in Operator](/pr-preview/pr-1233/kanvas/operator/views/index.md): Learn about Views in Operator mode 

- [Building a GCP Data Pipeline Design](/pr-preview/pr-1233/kanvas/tutorials/data-pipeline-gcp/index.md): Walk through creating the data-pipeline-gcp design in Kanvas, connecting GCP services in orbital-production.

- [Deleting a Design](/pr-preview/pr-1233/kanvas/tasks/designs/deleting-a-design/index.md): Permanently delete a design you own, and understand how deleting differs from unpublishing a design or removing it from a workspace.

- [Embedding Designs](/pr-preview/pr-1233/kanvas/designer/embedding-designs/index.md): How to embed your designs for sharing on your sites.

- [Performance Testing in Operator](/pr-preview/pr-1233/kanvas/operator/performance-testing/index.md): Measure the behavior of a running service from the Operator canvas, using saved performance profiles.

- [Working with Tags](/pr-preview/pr-1233/kanvas/designer/tagsets/index.md): Share design with other users and use control access to manage design access permissions and visibility.

- [Cross-Org Design Access: stellar-saas-platform](/pr-preview/pr-1233/kanvas/tutorials/stellar-saas-platform/index.md): Learn how Stellar Dynamics accesses and collaborates on a shared design with Orbital Labs using cross-org permissions in Kanvas.

- [Working with Canvas Objects](/pr-preview/pr-1233/kanvas/designer/canvas-objects/index.md): Add, copy, clone, lock, delete, style, reset and resize the shapes, sections, textboxes and components on your Kanvas Designer canvas.

- [Exporting Designs](/pr-preview/pr-1233/kanvas/designer/export-designs/index.md): How to export your designs for backup, sharing or offline use.

- [Kubernetes Request Flow – A Visual Guide](/pr-preview/pr-1233/kanvas/tutorials/kubernetes-request-flow/index.md): A visual walkthrough of how user requests flow through Kubernetes components using Kanvas.

- [Publishing Designs](/pr-preview/pr-1233/kanvas/designer/publishing-designs/index.md): Learn to publish, manage, and work with designs in Meshery with clear state transitions, role-based permissions, and common workflow FAQs.
- [Pinning Models to the Dock](/pr-preview/pr-1233/kanvas/designer/pin-model-to-dock/index.md): Learn how to pin and remove models from the dock in the Kanvas Designer for quick access.
- [Policy Engine](/pr-preview/pr-1233/kanvas/designer/relationship-evaluation/index.md): Choose how Kanvas evaluates relationships in your designs, understand the relationship indicator states, and diagnose failing or unexpected relationship results.

- [Canvas Actions](/pr-preview/pr-1233/kanvas/designer/canvas-actions/index.md): The canvas context menu - screenshots, the Help Center, keyboard shortcuts and canvas-wide editing actions.

- [Layout and Layers](/pr-preview/pr-1233/kanvas/designer/layout-and-layers/index.md): Arrange the components in a design automatically, and choose which entities the canvas draws.

- [Merging and Loading Designs](/pr-preview/pr-1233/kanvas/designer/merging-designs/index.md): Drag one design onto another to combine them, or open it in place of what is on the canvas.

- [Saving Designs](/pr-preview/pr-1233/kanvas/designer/saving-designs/index.md): How Kanvas persists your work, what the save indicator is telling you, and how to save a copy.

- [Configuring Components](/pr-preview/pr-1233/kanvas/designer/configuring-components/index.md): Edit a component's configuration on the canvas, using the form Kanvas builds for it and its inline help.

- [Help and Support](/pr-preview/pr-1233/kanvas/reference/help-and-support/index.md): How Kanvas submits support requests, and the two preconditions - a remote provider and a signed-in identity - that Help and Support requires.

## Cloud Documentation
- [Cloud Documentation](/pr-preview/pr-1233/cloud/index.md): Layer5 Cloud provides a powerful platform for managing and deploying your cloud infrastructure with flexibility and ease.


- [Customizing Webhooks](/pr-preview/pr-1233/cloud/guides/self-hosted/customizing-webhooks/index.md): Layer5 Cloud uses webhooks to automate approval flows and email notifications. This guide will help you customize and add your own custom webhooks.
- [Managing Workspaces](/pr-preview/pr-1233/cloud/guides/workspaces/managing-workspaces/index.md): Learn how to create, edit, delete, and configure your Workspaces.
- [Meshery Server Registration](/pr-preview/pr-1233/cloud/concepts/meshery-server-registration/index.md): How a Meshery Server registers itself with Layer5 Cloud as its Remote Provider, what data is recorded, and how re-registration is handled.

- [Metrics](/pr-preview/pr-1233/cloud/concepts/catalog/metrics/index.md): Metrics are quantifiable measures used to track and assess the status, progress, and performance of various activities and user interactions with Designs.

- [Five Narrative — Research Plan](/pr-preview/pr-1233/cloud/getting-started/meet-five/five-narrative-plan/index.md): Section-by-section map for infusing the Five narrative into Layer5 Cloud and Kanvas documentation.

- [Provider Admin Role](/pr-preview/pr-1233/cloud/concepts/identity-and-security/roles/provider-admin-roles/index.md): Provider Administrator Role is used for administration of Layer5 Cloud.

- [Setting up Layer5 Account](/pr-preview/pr-1233/cloud/getting-started/getting-started-with-layer5-account/index.md): With a personal account on Layer5 Cloud, you can import or create infrastructural designs, collaborate with others through workspaces and teams, manage your organizations and more.
- [Sharing a Workspace](/pr-preview/pr-1233/cloud/guides/tutorials/sharing-a-workspace/index.md): Learn how to control access to workspaces and their resources.

- [Support](/pr-preview/pr-1233/cloud/getting-started/support/index.md): If you have any questions, encounter any issues, or need assistance with anything related to our platform, please don't hesitate to reach out to us.
- [Creating a Design from Meshery Catalog Templates](/pr-preview/pr-1233/cloud/getting-started/creating-a-design-from-template/index.md): With this guide, you can create amazing cloud native designs for your infrastructure from already available templates in the meshery catalog.
- [Customizing Layer5 Cloud Deployment with Helm](/pr-preview/pr-1233/cloud/guides/self-hosted/deployment/helm-chart-values/index.md): Layer5’s Helm charts support a number of configuration options. Please refer to following table of configuration options.
- [Default Organization Roles](/pr-preview/pr-1233/cloud/concepts/identity-and-security/roles/organization-roles/index.md): By default, Organizations have two roles available: Organization Administrator and Organization Billing Manager.

- [Default Workspace Roles](/pr-preview/pr-1233/cloud/concepts/identity-and-security/roles/workspace-roles/index.md): By default, Workspaces have one role available: Workspace Administrator.

- [Extending the Academy](/pr-preview/pr-1233/cloud/academy/creating-content/extending-the-academy/index.md): A high-level guide to understanding the architecture, features, and workflow for creating custom content on the Layer5 Academy platform.

- [Integrating GitHub with Meshery](/pr-preview/pr-1233/cloud/getting-started/github-integration/index.md): Discover how to seamlessly connect your GitHub repository with Meshery, enabling easy import and management of your configuration files.
- [Leaderboard](/pr-preview/pr-1233/cloud/concepts/catalog/leaderboard/index.md): The Leaderboard is a visual representation of Designs, ranked based on key Metrics such as Opens, Downloads, Deployments, Clones, and Shares.

- [Learner Guide](/pr-preview/pr-1233/cloud/academy/using-the-academy/index.md): Learn how to navigate the Layer5 Academy platform, understand its features, and maximize your learning experience.

- [Managing Environments](/pr-preview/pr-1233/cloud/guides/workspaces/managing-environments/index.md): Learn how to view, create, and edit Environments, and how to assign Connections to an Environment or remove them from it.
- [Navigating Organizations](/pr-preview/pr-1233/cloud/guides/organizations/org-management/navigating-organizations/index.md): Learn how to navigate between different organizations in Layer5 Cloud and understand the order of precedence for organization settings.

- [Networking](/pr-preview/pr-1233/cloud/guides/self-hosted/planning/peer-to-peer-communication/index.md): Prepare and configure network services for your Layer5 Cloud deployment.
- [Organization Configuration Scenarios](/pr-preview/pr-1233/cloud/guides/organizations/configuration-scenarios/index.md): The named ways an organization can be configured in Layer5 Cloud — Hosted, Branded, and White-Label — and how to choose between them based on your domain, identity provider, and sign-in needs.

- [Promoting a Design from Staging to Prod](/pr-preview/pr-1233/cloud/guides/tutorials/promoting-a-design/index.md): Learn how to move a design from a staging workspace to a production workspace, with environment assignment and access approval.

- [Creating Content for the Academy](/pr-preview/pr-1233/cloud/academy/creating-content/creating-your-learning-path/index.md): A hands-on tutorial that walks you through creating, structuring, and testing custom content (learning paths, certifications, and challenges) for the Layer5 Academy.

- [Default Team Roles](/pr-preview/pr-1233/cloud/concepts/identity-and-security/roles/team-roles/index.md): By default, Organizations have two roles available: Team Admins and Team Managers.

- [Default User Role](/pr-preview/pr-1233/cloud/concepts/identity-and-security/roles/user-role/index.md): By default, members of an Organization are provided a User role.

- [Exploring the Catalog](/pr-preview/pr-1233/cloud/concepts/catalog/exploring-the-catalog/index.md): Discover how to browse, find, and interact with designs in the Catalog.
- [Identity Services](/pr-preview/pr-1233/cloud/guides/self-hosted/planning/identity-services/index.md): Understand identity services prerequisites and how to integrate your existing identity with OIDC.
- [User Invitations](/pr-preview/pr-1233/cloud/concepts/identity-and-security/users/user-invitations/index.md): Learn how to create custom, secure, and flexible invitations for new members.

- [Default Academy Roles](/pr-preview/pr-1233/cloud/concepts/identity-and-security/roles/academy-roles/index.md): By default, Academy has two roles available: Academy Administrator and Learner.

- [Integrating Assessments in the Academy](/pr-preview/pr-1233/cloud/academy/creating-content/integrating-assessments-in-the-academy/index.md): Learn how to spice up the Academy with interactive assessments that keep learners engaged.

- [Kanvas Snapshots](/pr-preview/pr-1233/cloud/guides/tutorials/gitops-snapshots/index.md): Connect Kanvas to your GitHub repo and see changes pull request-to-pull request.

- [Monitoring](/pr-preview/pr-1233/cloud/guides/self-hosted/planning/monitoring/index.md): Plan monitoring for Layer5 Cloud self-hosted deployments: metrics, logs, tracing, dashboards, and alerts.
- [Recognizing User and Contributor Milestones](/pr-preview/pr-1233/cloud/guides/tutorials/assigning-user-badges/index.md): Showcasing user and contributor achievements

- [User Management](/pr-preview/pr-1233/cloud/concepts/identity-and-security/users/user-management/index.md): Learn how to create, add, invite, and manage users within Layer5 Cloud.

- [Academy Instructor Console Guide](/pr-preview/pr-1233/cloud/academy/creating-content/instructor-console-guide/index.md): A comprehensive guide to using the Instructor Console. Learn how to track learner progress, analyze test performance, and manage your academy's content and metrics.

- [Building Certifications](/pr-preview/pr-1233/cloud/academy/creating-content/building-certifications/index.md): A step-by-step guide to building a professional certification in the Academy.

- [Tokens](/pr-preview/pr-1233/cloud/concepts/identity-and-security/tokens/index.md): API Tokens are used to authenticate to Layer5 Cloud's REST API. Generated on your user account's security tokens page. Tokens can be revoked at any time.
